description: This file manages a universal language model (LLM) context for Pipecat, supporting message history, multimedia content, and tool configurations. It includes classes and methods for creating, manipulating, and serializing LLM conversation contexts, with special handling for images and audio, and compatibility with OpenAI message types.

classes.name: LLMSpecificMessage
classes.description: A container for a context message specific to a particular LLM service, enabling service-specific message types while maintaining compatibility with the universal format.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Manages conversation context for LLM interactions, including message history, multimedia content, and tool configurations. Provides methods for creating, adding, filtering, and serializing messages, with support for images and audio.

methods.name: from_openai_context
methods.description: Creates a universal LLM context from an OpenAI-specific context; deprecated.

methods.name: create_image_url_message
methods.description: Creates a message containing an image URL with optional text.

methods.name: create_image_message
methods.description: Creates a message containing an image, encoding it as base64 data URI.

methods.name: create_audio_message
methods.description: Creates a message containing audio data encoded as base64.

methods.name: get_messages
methods.description: Retrieves current messages, optionally filtered by LLM-specific label.

methods.name: add_message
methods.description: Adds a single message to the conversation history.

methods.name: add_messages
methods.description: Adds multiple messages to the conversation history.

methods.name: set_messages
methods.description: Replaces all messages in the context.

methods.name: set_tools
methods.description: Sets the tools available for the LLM.

methods.name: add_image_frame_message
methods.description: Adds a message with an image frame, encoding it appropriately.

methods.name: add_audio_frames_message
methods.description: Adds a message with audio frames, encoding them as base64.

methods.name: _normalize_and_validate_tools
methods.description: Validates and normalizes the tools configuration.
